🎯 Mastering Pivot and Unpivot Transformations in Azure Data Factory

Whether you're reshaping flat files or preparing data for reporting, the Pivot and Unpivot transformations in Azure Data Factory can save you hours of manual effort and scripting. Here's a quick dive into what they do and when to use them. 🛠️

🔄 Pivot Transformation
📌 What it does: Converts rows into columns.
 📊 Use Case: Transforming transactional data into summary reports or wide format tables.
✅ Example:
 Transform a dataset like:
Year Metric. Value
2024. Revenue. 1000
2024. Expenses. 400

👉 Into:
Year. Revenue. Expenses
2024. 1000. 400

🔁 Unpivot Transformation
📌 What it does: Converts columns into rows.
 📊 Use Case: Normalizing wide datasets for analytics or loading into star schemas.

✅ Example:
 Transform a dataset like:
Year. Revenue Expenses. 
2024. 1000. 400

👉 Into:
Year. Metric. Value
2024. Revenue 1000
2024. Expenses. 400

💡 These transformations help:
Standardize incoming data
Simplify downstream data models
Reduce dependency on pre-transformed source data

Have you used Pivot or Unpivot in your ADF pipelines? Would love to hear how you applied it in real-world scenarios! 🔽
